keyFindings.description: The `docker run` line moved inside start_nats() and is now indented, so the envoy-e2e-local job's image scrape (.github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml:1196, sed -n 's/^docker run .* \([^ ]*nats:[^ ]*\) -js .*$/\1/p') matches nothing. Job 121078724439 at ca618736 fails its `Pull the NATS image the script starts` step with `::error::no nats image on the docker run line of scripts/e2e-local.sh` and skips the acceptance step, so the e2e-local acceptance this change extends no longer runs in CI at all. The same sed prints mirror.gcr.io/library/nats:2.10-alpine at main@origin and nothing at this head.

`age = time.Since(md.Timestamp)` measures time since the message was stored in the stream, not since its first delivery, so a message whose stream age already exceeds ENVOY_UNPLACEABLE_RETRY_WINDOW on its first delivery gets zero retries and is ACKed away at once. That is the cold-cache-after-a-reconnect case the issue exists for: a listener that was down, or whose durable was unbound during a rolling deploy (up to 135 s by cmd/listener's own subscribe path), replays a backlog whose messages are minutes old. unplaceableMaxDeliveries (18) already bounds the retries by count, so the age test adds no bound NumDelivered does not. No test covers an aged message.

Every resolveLiveRoleHolder error is answered through refuseBusUnavailable, which opens the body with `envoy: the message bus did not answer` and sets Retry-After: 1. Two of them are not a bus that did not answer: `role holder changed while resolving` (api.go:629), a lost CAS race against a live replacement in which every bus read answered; and bus.ErrPublishDenied (internal/bus/confirm.go:15,106), which is not a member of bus.ErrRefused (internal/bus/nats.go:680-710: ErrTooLarge, ErrInvalidSubject, ErrInvalidKey only), so a publish the listener's grant permanently denies now answers 503 with Retry-After: 1 and records outcome=bus_unavailable where it was a 500. A grant misconfiguration never succeeds on retry, and the body states a false cause.

The new reason taxonomy's prose is the inverse of its only consumer. handler.go:28-31 and session.go:30-33 say ReasonNoPushTarget/ErrNoPushTarget means a caller stops rather than retries; delivery.go:686 (placementMayChange := result.Reason != session.ReasonNone) retries it for the whole window, and docs/architecture.md:148-155 and AGENTS.md document it as retried. Nothing pins which is right: TestGiveUpCounterSeparatesItsTwoCauses runs on newListenerDeliveryHarness (main_test.go:3471-3514), which leaves unplaceableRetryWindow zero, so every delivery there is given up on its first attempt whatever its reason.

The comment justifying placementMayChange says `The interest path NAKs that failure itself ... so repeating it here would only repeat a refused HTTP request`, but that branch is reached only from the non-interest path: handler.go:88-94 returns no Err, so it lands in delivery.go:646's `result.Err == nil`, while the interest path returns ShouldNAK with an Err and never reaches it. Because handler.go:88-94 drops the delivery error and reasonFor maps a wire failure to ReasonNone, a push that failed on the wire - the normal path for every cross-machine delivery, since the interest's MachineID is not this listener's - is recorded reason=no_push_target, counted unplaceable_no_push_target, and given up on its first delivery.

A deferred message is NAKed with a delay and stays in the durable's pending set; consumerMaxAckPending is 256 and the durable filters every stream subject (durable.go:28-33). Before this change an unplaceable message was ACKed at once. More than 256 concurrent unplaceable messages - a machine whose sessions all went away - now hold that machine's whole durable for up to the retry window. TestUnplaceableRetryWindowFitsTheBoundsItDependsOn pins the window against consumerMaxDeliver and attemptCacheTTL but not against consumerMaxAckPending.

startLocalServer runs nats-server with no `-a`, so the shared account server binds every interface with tN:tN accounts, where the sibling scripts/e2e-local.sh passes `-a 127.0.0.1`. Test-only and opt-in through ENVOY_TEST_NATS_BIN; add `-a 127.0.0.1`.

api.go is now 1343 lines. The record machinery (api.go:312-430) is ~120 self-contained lines coupled to the rest only through writeJSON/writeJSONError/writeRoleHolderError, and belongs in its own file beside delivery.go and apiauth.go. Named as the one fast-follow.

record.refuse takes an outcome derivable from the status at every one of its 18 call sites (16 invalid_request, 2 capability_refused at the only 403s, 1 no_live_session at the only send 404), which is the drift writeNATSError's new int return was added to rule out. Not blocking.

The integration harnesses resolve the entry with sessions.Get alone (also e2e_test.go:177-183), so they no longer mirror agentSubjectDelivery's read-through. The deletion of SessionLookup/Deliver/DeliverWithResult is otherwise sound and TestE2E_AgentToAgent_RemoteMachine now asserts exactly one push, which it did not before.
